feature_definitions.argmax_switch: 1 if the dominant (mean-probability) slot over argmax_pre_frames before the candidate differs from the dominant slot over the confirmation window starting at the candidate frame; 0 otherwise; 0 with missing-imputed input when the pre-window does not exist
feature_definitions.gap_ms: length in milliseconds of the contiguous all-slots-inactive run immediately preceding the candidate crossing, capped at gap_cap_frames; 0 when another slot is active at the crossing (overlap signature)
feature_definitions.pre_depth_min: minimum probability of the previous dominant slot over the pre_depth_frames window ending at the gap start (or at the candidate frame when there is no gap); imputed 0.5 when the window does not exist
feature_definitions.pre_depth_mean: mean probability of the previous dominant slot over the same window; imputed 0.5 when the window does not exist
feature_definitions.rise_slope: candidate-slot probability at the last confirmation frame minus its probability at the candidate frame
feature_definitions.cross_probability: candidate-slot probability at the candidate frame
feature_definitions.peak_probability: maximum candidate-slot probability over the candidate frame through the confirmation window
feature_definitions.persistence_ms: candidate-slot active-run length in milliseconds measured from the candidate frame, capped at the confirmation window (base: 240, diagnostic: 480)
feature_definitions.same_slot_resume: 1 if the candidate slot was active at any frame in the resume_window_frames window before the candidate frame; 0 otherwise
feature_definitions.co_activity_max: maximum probability of any other slot over the candidate frame through the confirmation window
feature_definitions.return_flag: 1 if a slot other than the candidate slot that was active in the pre-window re-activates within the return_window_frames window after the candidate frame; 0 otherwise

verifier.standardization: fit on the eight training meetings per fold; scale values below 1e-6 are set to 1.0

a0.selection_rule: per fold, select the grid combination maximizing development recall_250 subject to development false events per hour <= dev_false_event_budget_per_hour; tie-break by lower false events per hour, then lower peak threshold, then lower persistence threshold, then higher gap maximum, then lower co-activity minimum; if no combination satisfies the budget, select the minimum false events per hour combination

embedding.replay_backend_note: Owner decision 2026-08-13: the B-arm full replay runs on Vulkan (GPU) to save wall-clock time; plan section 10's CPU example is overridden. Candidate stream, references, and probability features stay frozen from the R8 CPU dumps; embedding features come from the Vulkan replay. The CPU-vs-Vulkan numeric difference is a documented confound (R8 smoke parity: max abs diff 0.0907, mean 0.00067).

dump.header_layout: int64 chunk_index; int64 total_n; int32 dumped_cache_rows; int32 dumped_fifo_rows; int32 compression_this_or_prev; int32 compress_count
dump.row_layout: int32 frame_idx; float32 emb[512]; float32 preds[4]
dump.cadence_note: Dump after streaming_update_sync of every chunk whose chunk_index % 2 == 0; halves storage to ~13.8 GiB against the 24 GiB experiment ceiling.
dump.horizon_note: Only rows with frame_idx >= total_n - horizon_frames are dumped; any row older than 188 frames is never inside a feature window.

features.row_activation_rule: A row belongs to a slot only when max(preds) >= 0.5; its slot is argmax(preds). Rows below 0.5 are inactive and never used in similarity means.
features.before_window: rows with frame_idx in [candidate_frame - before_frames, candidate_frame - 1]
features.after_window: rows with frame_idx in [candidate_frame + after_lo_frames, candidate_frame + after_frames]
features.same_slot_similarity: cosine of (mean embedding of after-window rows assigned to the candidate slot, mean embedding of before-window rows assigned to the candidate slot)
features.best_other_similarity: maximum over slots != candidate slot of cosine(mean embedding of after-window rows assigned to that slot, mean embedding of after-window rows assigned to the candidate slot)
features.embedding_jump: euclidean distance between the two candidate-slot mean embeddings used for same_slot_similarity
features.compression_boundary: 1 if compression_this_or_prev == 1 in the dump record chosen for the candidate or in the immediately preceding dump record; 0 otherwise. compression_this_or_prev folds the previous chunk's compression flag so compressions landing between dumped chunks stay visible; compression events come from the same replay run (owner-override Vulkan), not from the R8 CPU per-chunk telemetry.
features.missing_rule: A similarity feature is NaN when the needed row set is empty. NaN embedding features (including all three similarities of a compression-boundary candidate, per plan section 7.2 default) are imputed with the per-fold training median computed on the eight training meetings only. Candidates whose after and before row sets are both empty are flagged excluded_embedding=1, kept in event-level evaluation, and reported as a count.
features.candidate_slot_source: frozen R8 CPU candidate stream (candidate slot at the crossing frame); Vulkan row argmax used for row assignment only

b1.model_form: identical discipline to R9-A1: per-fold L2-regularized logistic regression over normalized A1 features plus the four embedding features; MLP fallback with the verifier.mlp trigger; threshold selection on development folds out-of-fold scores
b1.comparison: A1 vs B1 curve comparison isolates the ceiling contribution of the speaker-cache embeddings

b2.entry_condition: B1 is valid (not Outcome D) AND candidate coverage is the binding constraint: evaluated after B1 as (B1 evaluation-curve recall at 100 false events/hour >= 0.6) OR (candidate ceiling recall < 0.9); candidate ceiling recall is 0.816 as frozen in R9-A
b2.candidate_definition: points inside continuously active single-slot runs where the cosine similarity between the slot's mean embedding over two adjacent fixed windows drops below the fixed threshold
b2.deduplication: 200 ms duplicate suppression inherited from the main candidate stream
b2.fail_fast: if the first fold produces no B2 candidates beyond noise (candidate count below 10), B2 stops and the R9-B ceiling is reported without it
b2.verification: same B1 machinery and feature definitions, evaluated with the same event construction and scoring protocol
